visual_brief.subject: A model that scores fixed choices instead of generating prose
verified_context: Microsoft released a model that returns calibrated probabilities over fixed answer options rather than generated text.
The API supports Boolean, multiple-choice, rating, and rubric-shaped decisions for routing, grading, screening, and agent action selection.
Applications can use confidence thresholds to act, defer, or request human review.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A constrained decision instrument measures several known paths and makes uncertainty visible instead of inventing a new destination.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A finely built analog calibration instrument receives one material sample, distributes pressure across several fixed unlabeled channels, and holds one ambiguous result at a separate review gate.

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant. The physical apparatus clearly separates fixed channels and a manual side station, though the human figure makes it slightly more literal than the preferred archive language.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant. The single input and four material channels are highly legible, but the separate review gate is compact and less distinct.
candidate_notes.C: Selected. One specimen enters a bank of fixed pathways while a visibly distinct coral route terminates at its own inspection threshold, expressing constrained choice and deferral without interface imagery.
